```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning=FALSE,

  error = FALSE,
  tidy = FALSE,
  dev = c("png", "pdf"),

  cache = TRUE,
  cache.lazy = FALSE)
```


```{r load, cache=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
library(DelayedArray)
library(zellkonverter)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(RUnit)
library(DelayedMatrixStats)
library(BiocSingular)
library(ggplot2)
library(GenomicDataStream)
})

file = "~/Downloads/4e6932db-5a78-40e4-b961-f87f66ba139a.h5ad"
# file = "~/4e6932db-5a78-40e4-b961-f87f66ba139a.h5ad"
sce_in = readH5AD(file, use_hdf5=TRUE, raw=TRUE, verbose=TRUE, uns=FALSE, obsp=FALSE, obsm=FALSE)
sce <- swapAltExp(sce_in, "raw") 
counts(sce) <- assay(sce, "X") 
sce$total_counts = colSums2(counts(sce))

lib.size = sce$total_counts
prior.count = 1
logcounts(sce) <- t(log2(t(counts(sce) + prior.count)) - log2(lib.size) + log2(1e6))
```



# Time vs number of genes
```{r numGenes}
k = 20

n_features = c(1000, 2000, 5000, 10000, nrow(sce))

res = lapply(n_features, function(p){

  res_time = system.time({
    res <- PCAstream(sce[seq(p),], k, threads=4)
  })

  data.frame(n_features = p, t(data.frame(res_time)))
})
res = do.call(rbind, res)
```

```{r numGenesPlot, cache=FALSE}
ggplot(res, aes(n_features, elapsed)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(aspect.ratio=1) +
  ylab("Time (seconds)")

```



# Time vs number of cells
```{r numCells}
k = 20

n_cells = c(1000, 5000, 20000, ncol(sce))

res = lapply(n_cells, function(nc){

  res_time = system.time({
    res <- PCAstream(sce[,seq(nc)], k, threads=4)
  })

  data.frame(nc = nc, t(data.frame(res_time)))
})
res = do.call(rbind, res)
```

```{r numCellsPlot, cache=FALSE}
ggplot(res, aes(nc, elapsed)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(aspect.ratio=1) +
  ylab("Time (seconds)")

```



# Time vs number of threads
```{r nThreads}
k = 20
res = lapply(c(1,2,4,6), function(threads){

  res_time = system.time({
    res <- PCAstream(sce, k, threads=threads)
  })

  data.frame(threads=threads, t(data.frame(res_time)))
})
res = do.call(rbind, res)
```


```{r nThreadsPlot, cache=FALSE}
ggplot(res, aes(threads, elapsed )) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(aspect.ratio=1, legend.position="none") +
  ylab("Time (seconds)")
```
